title: Thorium Brotherhood
wikitext:
==Summary==
The Thorium Brotherhood are an elite group of craftsmen who can reveal a number of high-end recipes if you gain enough faction with them.

===Lokhtos Darkbargainer===
Lokhtos is found in the [[Blackrock Depths]].  You can give him different items to receive faction with the Brotherhood.  Ten [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=8848 Dark Iron Ores], four [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=26938 Core Leathers], four [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=26592 Fiery Cores], four [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=26657 Lava Cores], or one [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=18634 Blood of the Mountain].  It seems that all five gifts result in the same faction and ''only'' faction.

Of the gifts, Dark Iron Ore can be mined in the [[Blackrock Depths]]. The Blood of the Mountain is a rare gem from the same veins.  Fiery and Lava Cores drop in the [[Molten Core]].  Core Leather can be skinned from certain beasts in the Molten Core, but requires [[Skinning]] of over 300.  A dagger, [http://www.thottbot.com/?i=13374 Finkle's Skinner], drops in the [[Blackrock Spire]] that can assist by providing +10 Skinning.

To reach friendly faction with the Brotherhood requires thirty turn-ins, honored requires sixty more, and revered requires one hundred and twenty more.  In all, that would be 3,100 Dark Iron Ores.

At each new level of faction, Lokhtos offers a new set of recipes.  These recipes require some combination of the items you can offer him to gain faction.

====Suspected Weapon Recipes====
* Dark Iron Reaver - Swordsmith
* Dark Iron Destroyer - Axesmith?, Unknown Faction
* Sulfuron Hammer - Hammersmith?, Unknown Faction

====Suspected Armor Recipes====
* [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=26629 Dark Iron Bracers] - Armorsmith
* Dark Iron Leggings - Armorsmith?
* Fiery Chain Girdle - Armorsmith?
* Fiery Chain Shoulders - Armorsmith?

====Suspected Tailor Recipes====
* Flarecore Mantle
* Flarecore Gloves

====Suspected Leatherworking Recipes====
* Black Dragonscale Boots - Dragonscale Leatherworking
* Molten Helm - Elemental Leatherworking
* Corehound Boots - Tribal Leatherworking

===Malyfous Darkhammer===
Malyfous is another member of the Brotherhood, found in Winterspring.  He gives the quests for [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?q=4779 Fiery Plate Gauntlets] and [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?q=5135 the Cap of the Scarlet Savant].  It isn't known whether more quests with him are unlocked with higher faction, but neither of these quests give Thorium Brotherhood faction.
